architecture: v3 (architecture 3, re-root after retirement: odor complaints against the valley's wind)
slot_note: seed RC01 (checkout release forward cost); v1 drafted and rejected at checkpoint A, v2 built and solved twice (signed-out club-app customers behind a checkout fall), retired 2026-10-10 and re-queued in wave 1 as re-root, Root-Cause; v3 re-roots in the same objective with a new domain, niche and Layer 2 pitfall
niche: a regional air district deciding which of the permitted odor sources around a valley town (a compost facility that began taking food waste, the county landfill up-valley, the town's wastewater plant, a rendering plant and a mushroom substrate yard) is behind the 2026 surge in residents' odor complaints, from the complaint log's household locations and times and the district's 5-minute valley wind record, before the 2027 season
answer: Ridgeway Organics' composting facility is behind the 2026 surge in odor complaints in Harlow Falls, and the district should take it to the hearing board for an order for abatement before the 2027 season.
stakeholder_role: the air district's enforcement supervisor, who leads the odor inspectors and brings abatement cases to the district hearing board

spine.entity: one 5-minute record of the district's town meteorological station

world.geography: United States, California (a fictional foothill valley town and air district)
world.org_type: a regional air quality management district handling public nuisance odor complaints
invented_names: Upper Kestrel Valley Air Quality Management District

driver: The decisive comparison sets each event's exposure against the same unit's exposure at the same clock hours on other days, because the events and the exposure both follow one daily cycle for reasons unrelated to any candidate; counting exposures among events, or normalizing by exposure over all hours, credits whichever candidate the daily cycle points at, and only the time-matched comparison at each unit's own geometry names the candidate whose exposure arrives with the events.
driver_concrete: Residents report odor when they are home, in the evening and early morning, and the valley wind turns with the clock (down-valley drainage at night), so the landfill up-valley lies upwind of the town on most nights whether or not anyone complains; only comparing the wind at each odor event's hour with the same hours on the other days of the season, at each household's own bearing to each facility, shows the compost facility in the side canyon upwind of complaint hours several times as often as of the same hours on other days.
stump: A competent solver forms the district's 499 odor events of May to September 2026, applies the procedure's upwind check to each and files the Pine Gulch Landfill, upwind of 210 events (the compost facility 69), where the golden is Ridgeway Organics' composting facility; the step that lands it there is counting upwind events, when the night drainage puts the landfill upwind of the town on most nights complaint or not (299.1 expected at the same hours), and dividing by the all-hours wind only moves the pick to Kestrel Valley Rendering (2.69 times) and drops the compost facility to 0.39, because the up-valley wind puts it upwind all day when nobody reports; set against the same clock hours on the season's other days it stands 42.6 events above expectation (69 against 26.4).
analyst_test: An analyst who cleans the complaint log into the district's odor events, reads the noticed time, vector-averages the 5-minute wind into hours and applies the 30-degree upwind check correctly still files the landfill by counting upwind events, or the rendering plant by dividing by each facility's all-hours upwind frequency, because both comparisons let the valley's daily wind cycle and the residents' evening reporting stand in for the source.
domain_test: Odor source attribution from complaint geometry and the local wind record (conditional probability by direction and its time-stratified form) is the air agency's own analysis; with another field's nouns there is no plume bearing from each household, no valley wind turning with the clock and no drainage flow putting one source upwind every night, and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: a complaint log merged from phone intake, the web form and the mobile app, with received and noticed times, double submissions and households filing under more than one contact
a 5-minute meteorological export in Pacific standard time year-round, wind direction to be vector-averaged across north, calms with no direction, a sensor outage with flagged gaps
facility operations kept in each operator's own idiom: a compost facility's monthly reports with turning logs, a landfill's daily tonnage, a treatment plant's biosolids log
household locations geocoded at parcel and at street-segment precision

differentiation.task180: task180 recovers a unit's true event rate from the quiet hours because instrument noise masks small events by day (completeness by hour); here nothing is masked: complaints and winds both follow the clock, so the comparison of each event's wind with the same hours on other days (a time-stratified referent at each household's own bearing) separates a confounded co-occurrence from the source, and the count of what was recorded is never in question.
differentiation.task97: task97 counts a place's cumulative history across every occupant to forecast a unit's repeat need; here nothing about a place's history decides: each odor event's wind is compared with the same clock hours on other days, a confound by the shared daily cycle.
differentiation.task128: task128 books one request per interval against a budget stated for the whole period; here the shared organ is only the context-artifact type (a monitoring export), and the decisive move is a time-matched comparison, not a binding resource.

lineage.architecture: v1 (first draft: the address check's forward weekly cost, self-healing exposure)
lineage.driver: The decisive move conditions a correctly measured pooled effect on a state each unit holds only until the effect first strikes it, because a struck unit repairs the property that exposed it; the state is reached only through a two-step join from the event records to a property of a different entity, ordered against the unit's own occurrence, so the forward cost is the expected first occurrences among units still holding the state as that pool drains period by period, while the pooled effect carried flat forward reproduces every closed case (no earlier case could alter the property) and overstates every forward period.
lineage.driver_concrete: The address check rejects only saved addresses holding a four-digit CP4 postcode without its three-digit extension, and an account that fails it once re-saves a full CP7 address within two days and never fails again, so the release's forward cost is the expected first failures among accounts still holding a CP4-only address over the quarter's 13 weeks, reached session to account to saved address, while the cohort-measured weekly loss carried flat reproduces both prior releases' reviewed effects (neither touched saved customer data) and overstates every forward week.
lineage.stump: A competent solver nets out the partner-referral mix, measures the release's per-session effect from the staggered flag cohorts balanced on channel and account age (the construction that reproduces both prior releases' reviewed effects), and applies that pooled effect to the quarter's planned sessions, filing a weekly cost about a quarter too high, because it never follows sessions through accounts to their saved addresses, where only four-digit-postcode addresses fail and an account that fails once re-saves and never fails again, so the share of checkouts still exposed falls week by week.
lineage.fate: drafted 2026-10-08 and never registered; redrawn at checkpoint A on 2026-10-09. It passed the guard only after its decisive pattern was relabelled from the note's A (past effect against forward yield) to E, and as E it still collides with task117 (registered in this batch) on time, E and a quantity figure, while A stays blocked inside the window by task107's v4 lineage. Its committed figure, the release's forward weekly cost, read as Forecasting and put the Root-Cause tag at risk. Its stump was weak: the staggered flag cohorts let a solver run an event study by weeks since exposure and watch the effect fade (an arithmetic symptom, task75's dead shape), the vendor's published address rules pointed at the address book, and both nearest measured exemplars scored above 0.50 because the model names the cause and loses only on sizing. Rolling back a flag-gated release is a flag flip, not a sprint. The self-healing exposure survives in v2 as a lower rung.

lineage.architecture: v2 (redraw at checkpoint A: signed-out club-app customers)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the loss carried by units that the records file as newcomers with no owning account but that belong to established accounts, reachable only by following a reference each unit carries through a second party's report to an identifier held on a different entity, because the channel that brings them strips the stored state that makes established accounts succeed; joined on the visible account key they read as incremental newcomers whose shortfall is harmless dilution, every closed case confirms that reading because in every closed case those accounts arrived with their state intact, and the loss is charged to the largest symptom it produces downstream instead of to the stripped state.
lineage.driver_concrete: The club app opens the store in its own browser, where nobody is signed in, so most of the shop-tab sessions the session log files as new, signed-out visitors are existing customers: each session's members'-price token resolves through the club's monthly redemption report to a member number, and the member number to the account that holds it on a store loyalty profile or as last season's SOCIO members' code redeemed on the account; signed out, they lose their saved address, saved card and card-on-file exemptions and convert at a fraction of their own usual rate, which makes their lost orders the largest current loss and puts it within reach of the parked one-time-code sign-in alone, while joined on the account key they look like new fans, both closed partner close-outs (open-web partners whose visitors arrived signed in) book partner traffic as dilution exactly, and their losses surface as typed-postcode failures at the address check and 3-D Secure challenges at payment.
lineage.stump: A competent solver gives the sprint to the card-authentication upgrade: it measures the address check on its flag cohorts and watches its losses drain as accounts re-save, follows each club-app session's members'-price token through the club's token report to a member number and the member number to the loyalty profile's `club_member_no`, finds only about a sixth of the Shop-tab sessions on existing accounts losing about 13 orders a week, books the rest as new-fan dilution the way both partner close-outs book partner traffic, and is left with the rise in 3-D Secure challenges (18 orders) as the largest loss, because it joins member numbers to accounts on the visible profile key alone and never reads last season's members' code (SOCIO and the member number) redeemed on the accounts in the promotions extract, which places 63 per cent of those sessions on existing accounts whose lost orders, 51 a week, are the largest current loss and which only the one-time-code sign-in reaches.

spine.entity: one storefront session that put an item in the basket, with its account when signed in, its traffic source and members'-price token, its new-visitor flag and the furthest checkout step it reached
